register.labelZh: WARM 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: warm to somebody 可以表示你起初未必喜歡或信任某人,但後來逐漸對他產生好感。；warm to something 可以描述你慢慢開始喜歡某項計劃、歌曲、故事、主題或活動。；warm up 可以描述身體、房間、食物或其他事物逐漸變暖。；warm somebody or something up 可以自然地描述把食物、飲品、衣物、房間或感到寒冷的人弄暖。
register.summaryEn: Warm to somebody shows that you did not immediately like or trust a person, but your feelings became more positive over time. Warm to something can describe slowly becoming interested in a plan, song, story, subject or activity. Warm up is useful when talking about your body, a room, food or another thing becoming warmer. Warm somebody or something up lets you talk naturally about heating food, drinks, clothes, rooms or a person who feels cold.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；使用 warm to 表示對某人或某事物逐漸產生好感。使用 warm up 表示某人或某物變暖;使用warm ... up 表示把某人或某物弄暖。When using it, him, her or them in WARM ... UP, place the word in the middle:warm it upwarm him upwarm them up在 WARM ... UP 中使用 it、him、her 或 them 時,把代名詞放在 WARM 和 UP 中間。；在 Come and warm up by the fire 中,核心片語動詞是 warm up。by the fire 只說明暖身的地點,並非固定片語的一部分,可以省略。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Use warm to when feelings become more positive over time. Use warm up when someone or something becomes warmer. Use warm... up when someone makes another person or thing warmer. In “Come and warm up by the fire”, the core expression is warm up. By the fire only tells us where the person becomes warm. It is optional.
